name: print-social-pink-distorted-music-poster-collage-grid
title: Hot-pink and black gig posters with halftone grain, stamped type and chrome teeth
whatItIs: A collage of several gig posters in pink-black duotone: a line-up list in a bold stamped face, a giant bold-outlined 'Day Break Signal', a close-up of chrome grills, a smoky blur 'Concrete Chaos' and a portrait with a cigarette, all with coarse grain and halftone.
whatItMeans: Raw and loud; grain and duotone feel like photocopied flyers.
techniques: Duotone every photo in pink and black.
Set lineups in stamped condensed type.
Flip or distort letters for chaos.

vocabulary.definition: A photo rendered in pink and black.
Letters flipped for a distorted effect.
